title: Upper bound on the bias
statement: Let $k,n,a,d$ be natural numbers with $1\leq k\leq n$, $a>0$, and $2a\leq d$. For the bias $\varepsilon=a/d$ associated with this input, one has $\varepsilon\leq\frac12$.
hypotheses_covered: The bias numerator a is positive
